title: Task - PII / Safety
evidence: The prompt contains no personally identifiable information. It uses impersonal colleague voice ('I'm putting together a playable prototype for our Thursday gameplay review'). Input files are: a generic coin texture (source_coin_token.png), a 3D bomb model (Bomb.glb), a scene reference screenshot (scene_reference.png), and a gameplay configuration file (gameplay_config.txt) — all game design assets with no personal data. Expected outputs are a Godot project ZIP, a screenshot, and a console log file. No names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, or other PII appear anywhere in the prompt, inputs, or expected outputs.
